body:
Written by a Codex session on 2026-10-15, at Ben's request.

Suggested full doc-note for the existing MAM form `חָ֥֫י`:

`א=חָ֥י (השמטת סימן העולה)`

In Wikisource wikitext:

```text
{{נוסח|חָ֥֫י|א=חָ֥י (השמטת סימן העולה)}}
```

This uses the same wording as Psalms 68:20, 86:2 and 125:2. The Aleppo reading is taken from the Introduction's list cited above; no manuscript image was checked.
correction_body:
Written by a Codex session on 2026-10-15. Syntax correction to my comment above: the second parameter needs explicit `2=` because its value contains `=`. The proposed Hebrew note is unchanged. Full usable wikitext:

```text
{{נוסח|חָ֥֫י|2=א=חָ֥י (השמטת סימן העולה)}}
```
readback: Exact original comment and correction verified including Hebrew codepoints; issue body unchanged.
